name: implement-review
description: Review loop for staged changes. Detects content type, prepares a review request for Codex (Terminal-relay manual default, opt-in Auto-terminal codex-exec subprocess, or IDE plugin) or an explicitly selected Agy, Copilot, or headless Claude backend, categorizes feedback, revises, and iterates. Works for code, papers, proposals, or any text-based output.

findings.excerpt: | Citation / paper / author existence | `WebSearch` for title and author; `WebFetch` arXiv / DOI URL; cross-check against the project's `.bib` file |
| Link reachability | `WebFetch` of the URL; HEAD request via curl |
2. Verification path: `WebSearch "Smith 2023 <topic keywords>"`, then `WebFetch arxiv.org/abs/<id>` if a candidate surfaces.
